Big Meh.
Maps are either okay or complete garbage.
The portal mechanic is very map dependent and isn't very good, its too blurry to use as a murder hole and the maps don't want you to use it as a shortcut. Not to mention it's VERY easy to counter, just portal on top of it.
Matchmaking is iffy, you either stomp or get stomped.
The 8v8v8 mode sucks, maps are way too big. You are always either too late to join a fight or running for ages to get to an objective that's going to be flipped while you are running to the next one.

Time to kill feels fine, the guns are nice, the factions are ok too. Character customization is very limited, its whole skin or nothing. No option to change colors or change parts of your suit.

Overall, a pretty forgettable experience.
But at least its free. I'll sink some more hours in but i'm not recommending it to my friends.

I dropped this trash so fast after the relaunch that I actually forgot to change my review.

Seems the devs did too.

Don't bother with anything this studio creates. They had lightning in a bottle with Splitgate 1, and it seems they're desperately trying to recapture that initial spark, to the point of abandoning anything that doesn't have that "lightning" they're trying to recapture.

It hasn't worked. Game's a mess, and at this point I'd rather a different studio with an actual vision pick up the concept and run with it.

Splitgate didn't need BR or any of the extra nonsense, just to perfect its own niche. Instead they tried to jump on the fad train to draw in a few generally uninterested suckers and practically shattered their own success for it.

Avoid like the plague. A generally uninspired shooter that has the bones of a titan, with the meat of a decayed horse piloted by a nervous system actively trying to cannibalise itself.

Frequent crashes, borderline ridiculous cosmetic monetisation, and an uninspired Battle Royale mode.

Admittedly, the Arena (Non-BR gameplay) is actually pretty fun when it works. There's a good game in here somewhere, but it's buried under mountains of other stuff.

An unfortunate downgrade from the original Splitgate.

The game feels far less balanced than the original Classes/Heroes are not needed and make the game feel less balanced especially when both classes and weapons also gets level up unlocks that give players a significant edge in combat when fighting people without upgrades.

The changes to portals are awful, being able to place portals over both teammate and enemy portals really disrupts the gameplay and constantly causes problems with movement flow.

Also...
The addition of sliding and wall climbing doesn't feel needed, the new maps suck, the 4v4v4v4v4v4 (24 player deathmatch) gamemode maps feel way too big and empty that it somehow feels less chaotic than the standard 4v4. the new fire cracker gamemode sucks as respawns are too quick leading to both teams throwing themselves at the objective in a way that doesn't feel fun.

All of the new changes on top of a "beta" with a full store and a battlepass at launch just makes this feel like a step away from the fun and unique game that Splitgate was and instead makes this feel like a game chasing trends and less of a passion project.

This game's current UI is already fairly abysmal for navigation, but it gets worse with a controller. After their latest update I cannot recommend this game to anyone currently, the balancing of not being able to access more weapons than a Assault Rifle and Carbine already stinks but then god forbid if you want to use a controller, the aiming has issues when using Xinput API (One of the most commonly used APIs for controllers) where it will remain trailing in one direction and removes your aiming ability for brief moments. 

Yes, mouse and keyboard is objectively a better controller scheme for more precise aiming but not everyone has access to being able to use one due to space issues or hand issues, even so, there should not be controller support that literally fails to be stable. I even tested this with Aim Assist being turned off completely and still suffering the same issues as before. This was NOT a problem before in the beta, and it was not a problem in the last Splitgate.

To be honest, this game plays worse than the OG splitgate. the gate mechanics are more clunky and while the weapon choices is larger it doesn't feel more impactful. 

But since the choice is either the OG splitgate disappearing or this game existing, I guess its a recommend.

Enjoying the gunplay and finding it to be quite fun. I think it's poised to have a lot more content ahead, both on character-side and gameplay-side. Balancing will come with a little more time, but for now, still worth playing.
